app.tagline: Everything you watch. One single log.

welcome.title: Your <0>log</0> is empty.
welcome.body: Every title you add writes a dated line. Every time you rewatch something, that's another viewing, with its own date and its own rating. After a while you're no longer looking at a list: you're rereading your history.
welcome.legal: stays on this device · no account · exportable data

library.title: Library
library.cycleLabel: Status of {{title}} — tap to advance, long press to choose
library.hint: tap the pill = next status · long press = choose
library.emptyHint: Search for a title above: one tap on + adds it to « to watch ».
library.emptyFilterHint: No title has this status yet.
library.hintDesktop: click the pill = next status · right-click = choose · click the row = media page

log.title: LOG
log.emptyHint: Add a title, or record a memory: everything you do lands here.

stats.title: Stats
stats.excludedRuntime: {{count}} series left out of the total: TMDB has no runtime for it
stats.excludedRuntime_other: {{count}} series left out of the total: TMDB has no runtime for them
stats.noGenres: no genres known yet: open a title to fetch them
stats.excludedGenres: {{count}} title left out of the ranking: its page was never opened
stats.excludedGenres_other: {{count}} titles left out of the ranking: their pages were never opened
stats.emptyHint: Log a first viewing: every figure comes from your data, never from a sample.
stats.excludedProgress: {{count}} title in progress left out: its progress is only dated under « all »
stats.excludedProgress_other: {{count}} titles in progress left out: their progress is only dated under « all »

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.what: This address doesn't match any screen.

debug.title: /debug
debug.note: media_state is derived: rebuilding it loses no data. events is the source of truth and is never modified.
debug.repushAll: re-push the whole journal and cache
debug.syncDisabled: engine at rest: no account on this device.
debug.syncUnauthorized: session expired — please sign in again.
debug.syncNote: cursors say how far this client has pulled from the server. Re-pushing everything is safe: the server ignores what it already knows.

attribution.tmdb: Movie and TV data provided by TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

search.emptyHint: Check the spelling, or try the original title.
search.unavailableHint: The service is not responding. Titles you already added stay available.
search.offlineHint: Set the title aside: you'll confirm it when the network is back.
search.confirmPending: Confirm the titles you set aside

media.journalEmpty: nothing yet. the first move writes the first line.
media.rewatchHint: back to « watching » · opens watch #{{number}} in the journal
media.cancelHint: long-press an entry to undo it

backdate.hintYear: « year » precision · the journal will show « {{year}} »
backdate.hintDay: « day » precision · the journal will show « {{date}} »
backdate.hintUnknown: no date · the journal will place it last
backdate.attachedWhy: a watch was open and older than this date: it was closed, not duplicated.
backdate.createdWhy: no open watch preceded this date: a new cycle was opened.

landing.title: Everything you watch.<0/>One single <1>log</1>.
landing.subtitle: Add a title in one gesture, track your progress, rate, rewatch, and keep the full history of your watching life.
landing.reassurance: no card · exportable data · tmdb api

login.legal: no password · one email link is enough
login.mergeNote: your local data stays on this device: signing in merges it with your account, nothing gets overwritten.
login.errorInvalid: code or link rejected — expired or already used.
login.errorLocked: too many attempts: this code is locked. Request a new email.
login.errorRateLimited: too many requests — wait a moment before retrying.
login.errorOffline: offline — get back on the network and retry.
login.errorUnavailable: the service is not responding. Try again shortly.

loginLink.failedBody: link expired, already used, or invalid.

firstPull.error: sync was interrupted. Everything already retrieved is safe.

settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.activateBody: An account syncs your journal across your devices. Without one, everything stays here — and everything works.
settings.privacyWhere: your data lives on this device and, if you enable sync, on a personal server — not with a third party.
settings.privacyLogout: signing out pauses sync; nothing is deleted, here or there.
settings.privacyPurge: erasing local data empties this device and signs you out; the server keeps your backup.
settings.pseudoHint: public identity — visible to your friends
settings.purgeBody: The journal, titles, first name and settings on this device will be erased, and you will be signed out. Whatever was synced stays on the server.
settings.purgeUnpushed: {{count}} unsynced item will be permanently lost.
settings.purgeUnpushed_other: {{count}} unsynced items will be permanently lost.

friends.title: Friends
friends.hint: tap a friend to open their profile
friends.empty: Your log is better with company.
friends.needAccount: Social needs an account: it's what links your log to other people's.
friends.needPseudo: Pick a handle first — that's how others will find you.
friends.offline: offline — the list reloads when the network is back
friends.rateLimited: too many lookups — try again in a few minutes

loginOauth.unverified: your address isn't verified with that provider. Verify it there and try again — or sign in by e-mail.
